ei.title: 이야기 — 기차표 요일 착각과 좌석 교환

fullPassage: Nathan boarded the train on Saturday evening. As he made his way to his seat, he found someone already sitting there. Confused, he checked his ticket and realized his mistake ― it was for Sunday, not Saturday! A flush of panic spread across his face. He quickly approached a train attendant and explained the situation. "Is there anything I can do to resolve this?" Nathan asked. "Don't worry, sir. We still have seats available," the attendant said with a reassuring smile. Nathan exchanged his old ticket for a new one, his worries melting away. Settling into his seat, he let out a deep breath, feeling the tension in his shoulders ease as the train began to move.

questions.stem:
주어진 글 다음에 이어질 글의 순서로 가장 적절한 것은?

Nathan boarded the train on Saturday evening. As he made his way to his seat, he found someone already sitting there.

(A) He quickly approached a train attendant and explained the situation. "Is there anything I can do to resolve this?" Nathan asked.

(B) Confused, he checked his ticket and realized his mistake ― it was for Sunday, not Saturday! A flush of panic spread across his face.

(C) "Don't worry, sir. We still have seats available," the attendant said with a reassuring smile. Nathan exchanged his old ticket for a new one, his worries melting away.

det.korean: 탑승→앉은 사람 발견 → (B) 표 확인하고 날짜 착각 깨달음 → (A) 승무원에게 도움 요청 → (C) 좌석 제공 + 표 교환
det.analysis:
① (B) — (A) — (C): 착각→요청→해결 ←정답
② (A) — (B) — (C): 요청이 착각 전에 옴 부자연
③ (C) — (A) — (B): 해결이 먼저 올 수 없음
④ (B) — (C) — (A): 해결 후 요청 부자연
